remarks: 70 Washington Street is the Street Address. Available Unfurnished ($2500/mo) or Furnished ($3500/mo)! This sun drenched bright front facing condo is right in the middle of SoNo with great proximity to MetroNorth RR, great restaurants, shops, SoNo Collection Mall, Veterans Park and so much more. While a super location to walk from, this unit includes one parking permit (can have up to 3 registered users) for Haviland parking lot in rear. Inside you will appreciate a renovated unit with updated kitchen and bath as well as hardwood floors, C/A, in-unit laundry and tons of character. Must have excellent credit, employment history and references. No smoking. Flexible rental terms and Pets will be considered on case by case basis.
